definitions.explanation: A commissioned officer in the military — someone holding the rank of second lieutenant or above, who commands enlisted personnel.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{陸軍|りくぐん}の{将校|しょうこう}だった。
{将校|しょうこう}たちが{作戦|さくせん}を{練|ね}っている。
examples.english: The officers are working out a strategy.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{将校|しょうこう}が{部隊|ぶたい}を{率|ひき}いて{前線|ぜんせん}に{向|む}かった。
examples.english: A young officer led the unit toward the front line.

notes:
Refers to commissioned officers (second lieutenant and above). A formal, somewhat historical military term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陸軍|りくぐん}{将校|しょうこう}: army officer
- {若|わか}い{将校|しょうこう}: a young officer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {士官|しかん}: officer — a near-synonym, also used for naval officers
- {兵士|へいし}: soldier; enlisted man — the ranks that officers command
